body:
Hi there! McFanta_ Here!

I got appealed on my account Nicolai156.

I am here to say that thanks for appealing the ban on my account Nicolai156 <33!

Could these fellow accounts be appealed? 

I want this account my main account McFanta_ appealed and my account Xx_FireWorks_Xx. The Xx_FireWorks_Xx that I ban evaded on is my brother's account which I really want appealed. And this account is my main account and usually I don't play on the Nicolai156 account so Am I allowed to be unbanned on these accounts too?

I used this account to ban evade for my alt Nicolai156 which got unbanned. I used my brother's account Xx_FireWorks_Xx formelly known as Krisdenkule8 to also ban evade Nicolai156. Since Nicolai156 is unbanned. Could you please unban this account which is my main account and my brother's account Xx_FireWorks_Xx formelly known as Krisdenkule8.

Kind Regards

McFanta_  (The Owner Of The Nicolai156 account!)
